objective: Freeze a symbolic, deterministic, mutation-resistant exactly-ten-or-abstain decision contract and bounded exhaustive reference oracle before optimized implementations.

expertise.responsibility: estimands, unknown/measured parameter states, sensitivity, and power-input discipline
exact-ten constrained selection, value floor, feasibility, and exhaustive oracle
physical-location uniqueness, protected masks, and Stage-1 isolation
public properties, real mutants, permutation tests, and differential enumeration
keep firm utility/cost inputs symbolic and prevent invented thresholds

hard_constraints: ISSUE contains exactly 10 distinct eligible physical location IDs; otherwise ABSTAIN_NO_VALID_TEN
protected or unresolved protection state can never clear
only Stage-1 observations at or before decision_as_of may affect selection
business value is optimized before proximity; routing cannot cross the registered value-retention floor
unknown empirical or human-authoritative parameters remain unknown or enter explicit sensitivity sets

evaluator_first.implementation_may_start_after: The evaluator rejects missing/undefined estimands, invented power inputs, wrong cardinality, protected aliases, duplicate physical locations, Stage-2 leakage, and proximity-first selection.

best_of_n.reason: cannot certify composition, interference, or value-floor constrained feasibility
adds solver/tolerance complexity before a bounded exhaustive truth source exists

best_of_n.alternative: bounded exhaustive enumeration plus deterministic lexicographic tie-break
best_of_n.reason: small-domain exact truth is transparent and suitable for differential testing

claim_ceiling: Formal/specification through public mutation-resistant proof only; no empirical parameter, feasibility, predictive, causal, or commercial claim.
